---
title: "League Scoring from Play-by-Play"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    df_print: paged
params:
  pbp_file: "pbp9925.csv"
  include_kneels_spikes: true       # official box score counts kneels as rushes, spikes as incompletions
  adjust_pa_for_return_tds: false   # true = subtract 6 per opponent return TD from points allowed
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
```

Scoring is **lower = better**: yards, TDs and catches are negative; turnovers, sacks, misses and attempts are positive.
Works on nflfastR-style play-by-play (1999+).

# 1. Load data

```{r load}
pbp <- read_csv(params$pbp_file, guess_max = 100000, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Plays that count: drop penalty-nullified plays; keep 2-pt tries separate
valid <- pbp %>% filter(!is.na(play_type), play_type != "no_play")
reg   <- valid %>% filter(is.na(two_point_attempt) | two_point_attempt == 0)
twopt <- valid %>% filter(two_point_attempt == 1)

# Standardize every player event to one row: who, where (game/quarter/half/play), what stat
ev <- function(df, id, name, team, stat, value = 1) {
  df %>% transmute(game_id, play_id, qtr, game_half, season, week, season_type,
                   team = {{ team }}, player_id = {{ id }}, player_name = {{ name }},
                   stat = stat, value = {{ value }}) %>%
    filter(!is.na(player_id), !is.na(value))
}
```

# 2. Player events

## Passing, rushing, receiving

```{r offense}
pass_plays <- reg %>% filter(play_type %in% c("pass", "qb_spike"))
py   <- pass_plays %>% filter(sack == 0 | is.na(sack)) %>% ev(passer_player_id, passer_player_name, posteam, "py", passing_yards)
inc  <- pass_plays %>% filter(incomplete_pass == 1 | interception == 1) %>% ev(passer_player_id, passer_player_name, posteam, "inc")   # an INT also counts as an incompletion
ptd  <- pass_plays %>% filter(pass_touchdown == 1)  %>% ev(passer_player_id, passer_player_name, posteam, "ptd")
int  <- pass_plays %>% filter(interception == 1)    %>% ev(passer_player_id, passer_player_name, posteam, "int")
sk   <- pass_plays %>% filter(sack == 1)            %>% ev(passer_player_id, passer_player_name, posteam, "sk")
pc2  <- twopt %>% filter(two_point_conv_result == "success", play_type == "pass") %>% ev(passer_player_id, passer_player_name, posteam, "p2pc")

rush_plays <- reg %>% filter(play_type == "run" | (params$include_kneels_spikes & play_type == "qb_kneel")) %>%
  mutate(rid = coalesce(rusher_player_id, passer_player_id), rname = coalesce(rusher_player_name, passer_player_name))
ry   <- rush_plays %>% ev(rid, rname, posteam, "ry", rushing_yards)
ra   <- rush_plays %>% ev(rid, rname, posteam, "ra")
rtd  <- rush_plays %>% filter(rush_touchdown == 1) %>% ev(rid, rname, posteam, "rtd")
r2   <- twopt %>% filter(two_point_conv_result == "success", play_type == "run") %>% ev(rusher_player_id, rusher_player_name, posteam, "p2pr")

tgt_plays <- pass_plays %>% filter(!is.na(receiver_player_id), sack == 0 | is.na(sack))
ret  <- tgt_plays %>% ev(receiver_player_id, receiver_player_name, posteam, "ret")
rec  <- tgt_plays %>% filter(complete_pass == 1)   %>% ev(receiver_player_id, receiver_player_name, posteam, "rec")
rey  <- tgt_plays %>% filter(complete_pass == 1)   %>% ev(receiver_player_id, receiver_player_name, posteam, "rey", receiving_yards)
retd <- tgt_plays %>% filter(pass_touchdown == 1)  %>% ev(receiver_player_id, receiver_player_name, posteam, "retd")
re2  <- twopt %>% filter(two_point_conv_result == "success", play_type == "pass") %>% ev(receiver_player_id, receiver_player_name, posteam, "p2pre")
```

## Kicking and punting

Missed FG distance buckets stack on top of the flat missed-FG penalty.

```{r kicking}
fgm <- valid %>% filter(field_goal_attempt == 1, field_goal_result %in% c("missed", "blocked")) %>%
  mutate(dist = coalesce(kick_distance, yardline_100 + 17),
         bucket = case_when(dist < 40 ~ "fgm0", dist < 50 ~ "fgm40", dist < 60 ~ "fgm50", TRUE ~ "fgm60"))
fgm_flat <- fgm %>% ev(kicker_player_id, kicker_player_name, posteam, "fgm")
fgm_bkt  <- fgm %>% transmute(game_id, play_id, qtr, game_half, season, week, season_type,
                              team = posteam, player_id = kicker_player_id,
                              player_name = kicker_player_name, stat = bucket, value = 1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(player_id))
patm <- valid %>% filter(extra_point_attempt == 1, extra_point_result %in% c("failed", "blocked")) %>%
  ev(kicker_player_id, kicker_player_name, posteam, "patm")
ptb  <- valid %>% filter(punt_blocked == 1) %>% ev(punter_player_id, punter_player_name, posteam, "ptb")
```

## Fumbles and return TDs

```{r misc}
fum_long <- bind_rows(
  valid %>% filter(!is.na(fumbled_1_player_id)) %>%
    transmute(game_id, play_id, qtr, game_half, season, week, season_type,
              team = fumbled_1_team, player_id = fumbled_1_player_id, player_name = fumbled_1_player_name,
              lost = (!is.na(fumble_recovery_1_team) & fumble_recovery_1_team != fumbled_1_team) |
                     (fumble_lost == 1 & is.na(fumbled_2_player_id))),
  valid %>% filter(!is.na(fumbled_2_player_id)) %>%
    transmute(game_id, play_id, qtr, game_half, season, week, season_type,
              team = fumbled_2_team, player_id = fumbled_2_player_id, player_name = fumbled_2_player_name,
              lost = !is.na(fumble_recovery_2_team) & fumble_recovery_2_team != fumbled_2_team))
fum  <- fum_long %>% mutate(stat = "fum",  value = 1)
fuml <- fum_long %>% filter(lost) %>% mutate(stat = "fuml", value = 1)

# Classify every return TD once (used for players AND teams)
ret_td <- valid %>% filter(return_touchdown == 1) %>%
  mutate(td_type = case_when(
    kickoff_attempt == 1 ~ "krtd",
    punt_attempt == 1 & punt_blocked == 1 ~ "blkkrtd",
    punt_attempt == 1 ~ "prtd",
    field_goal_attempt == 1 | extra_point_attempt == 1 ~ "blkkrtd",
    interception == 1 ~ "inttd",
    fumble == 1 & td_team == posteam ~ "ftd",
    fumble == 1 ~ "frtd",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>% filter(!is.na(td_type))
ret_td_p <- ret_td %>% transmute(game_id, play_id, qtr, game_half, season, week, season_type,
                                 team = td_team, player_id = td_player_id, player_name = td_player_name,
                                 stat = td_type, value = 1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(player_id))
```

# 3. Player scoring

```{r player-scoring}
player_w <- c(py = -0.04, inc = 1, ptd = -4, int = 10, sk = 2, p2pc = -1,
              ry = -0.25, ra = 1, rtd = -2, p2pr = -1,
              rey = -0.05, rec = -3, retd = -2, p2pre = -1, ret = 3,
              patm = 5, fgm = 1, fgm0 = 10, fgm40 = 10, fgm50 = 5, fgm60 = 3,
              ptb = 25,
              fum = 5, fuml = 10, krtd = -6, prtd = -6, ftd = -6, inttd = -6, frtd = -6, blkkrtd = -6)

# Long format: one row per player per play per stat
player_long <- bind_rows(py, inc, ptd, int, sk, pc2, ry, ra, rtd, r2, ret, rec, rey, retd, re2,
                         fgm_flat, fgm_bkt, patm, ptb, fum, fuml, ret_td_p) %>%
  select(game_id, play_id, qtr, game_half, season, week, season_type, team, player_id, player_name, stat, value) %>%
  mutate(points = value * unname(player_w[stat]))
stopifnot(!anyNA(player_long$points))

score <- function(df, w) {
  for (s in setdiff(names(w), names(df))) df[[s]] <- 0   # stat never occurred -> 0
  df$points <- as.numeric(as.matrix(df[, names(w)]) %*% w)
  df
}

# Wide format: one row per player per game
player_game_scores <- player_long %>%
  group_by(game_id, season, week, season_type, player_id, stat) %>%
  summarise(team = first(team), player_name = first(player_name), value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value, values_fill = 0) %>%
  score(player_w)

player_game_scores %>% select(player_name, team, week, points) %>% arrange(desc(points)) %>% head(10) %>% kable(digits = 2, caption = "Worst 10 individual games")

#these stats are a little off
```

# 4. Team scoring (D/ST + team loss)

```{r team-scoring}
games <- valid %>% distinct(game_id, season, week, season_type, home_team, away_team, home_score, away_score)
team_games <- bind_rows(
  games %>% transmute(game_id, season, week, season_type, team = home_team, opp = away_team, pf = home_score, pa_raw = away_score),
  games %>% transmute(game_id, season, week, season_type, team = away_team, opp = home_team, pf = away_score, pa_raw = home_score))

tev <- function(df, team, stat, value = 1) df %>% transmute(game_id, team = {{ team }}, stat = stat, value = {{ value }}) %>% filter(!is.na(team))

fr <- bind_rows(
  valid %>% filter(!is.na(fumble_recovery_1_team), !is.na(fumbled_1_team), fumble_recovery_1_team != fumbled_1_team) %>% tev(fumble_recovery_1_team, "d_fr"),
  valid %>% filter(!is.na(fumble_recovery_2_team), !is.na(fumbled_2_team), fumble_recovery_2_team != fumbled_2_team) %>% tev(fumble_recovery_2_team, "d_fr"))

team_events <- bind_rows(
  reg   %>% filter(sack == 1) %>% tev(defteam, "d_sk"),
  reg   %>% filter(interception == 1) %>% tev(defteam, "d_int"),
  fr,
  ret_td %>% tev(td_team, paste0("d_", ret_td$td_type)) %>% filter(stat != "d_ftd"),   # FTD is an individual/offense stat
  valid %>% filter(punt_blocked == 1 | field_goal_result == "blocked" | extra_point_result == "blocked") %>% tev(defteam, "d_blkk"),
  pbp   %>% filter(safety == 1) %>% tev(defteam, "d_sf"),   # includes safeties from penalties (no_play rows)
  valid %>% filter(extra_point_result == "safety" | two_point_conv_result == "safety") %>% tev(defteam, "d_1psf"),
  valid %>% filter(defensive_two_point_conv == 1) %>% tev(defteam, "d_2ptret")
) %>% group_by(game_id, team, stat) %>% summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value, values_fill = 0)

off_yards <- valid %>% filter(play_type %in% c("pass", "run", "qb_kneel", "qb_spike"),
                              is.na(two_point_attempt) | two_point_attempt == 0) %>%
  group_by(game_id, team = posteam) %>% summarise(off_yds = sum(yards_gained, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

opp_ret_tds <- ret_td %>% filter(td_type != "ftd") %>% count(game_id, scorer = td_team, name = "ret_tds")

team_w <- c(d_sk = -1, d_int = -2, d_fr = -2, d_inttd = -6, d_frtd = -6, d_krtd = -6, d_prtd = -6, d_blkkrtd = -6,
            d_blkk = -2, d_sf = -2, d_1psf = 1000, d_2ptret = -2)

team_game_scores <- team_games %>%
  left_join(team_events, by = c("game_id", "team")) %>%
  left_join(off_yards %>% rename(opp = team, ya = off_yds), by = c("game_id", "opp")) %>%
  left_join(opp_ret_tds %>% rename(opp = scorer, opp_ret_tds = ret_tds), by = c("game_id", "opp")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(starts_with("d_"), opp_ret_tds), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)),
         pa = pa_raw - if (params$adjust_pa_for_return_tds) 6 * opp_ret_tds else 0,
         pa_pts = 0.25 * pa + case_when(pa == 0 ~ -5, pa <= 6 ~ -4, pa <= 13 ~ -3, pa <= 17 ~ -1, pa <= 27 ~ 0,
                                        pa <= 34 ~ 1, pa <= 45 ~ 3, TRUE ~ 5),
         ya_pts = case_when(ya < 100 ~ -5, ya < 200 ~ -3, ya < 300 ~ -2, ya < 350 ~ 0, ya < 400 ~ 1,
                            ya < 450 ~ 3, ya < 500 ~ 5, ya < 550 ~ 6, TRUE ~ 7),
         tl = as.integer(pf < pa_raw)) %>%   # ties = no loss
  score(team_w) %>%
  mutate(defst_points = points + pa_pts + ya_pts, tl_points = tl * 1, points = NULL)

team_game_scores %>% group_by(team) %>% summarise(defst_points = sum(defst_points), losses = sum(tl)) %>%
  arrange(desc(defst_points)) %>% head(5) %>% kable(digits = 2, caption = "Worst 5 D/STs for the season")
```

# 5. Secondary analysis: highest-scoring play, quarter and half

"Highest" here means the **most points**, which in this league is the **worst** performance. Individual players only (D/ST excluded).
Quarter 5 / `Overtime` is overtime. Player-level team loss isn't included.

```{r peaks-setup}
# helper: stat-by-stat breakdown of one scoring window
breakdown <- function(rows) {
  rows %>% group_by(stat) %>% summarise(count_or_yards = sum(value), points = sum(points), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(points)))
}
```

## Highest-scoring play

```{r peak-play}
play_scores <- player_long %>%
  group_by(game_id, play_id, player_id) %>%
  summarise(player_name = first(player_name), team = first(team), season = first(season), week = first(week), qtr = first(qtr),
            points = sum(points), stats = paste(stat, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(pbp %>% select(game_id, play_id, desc), by = c("game_id", "play_id")) %>%
  arrange(desc(points))

# Blocked punts are a flat 25 for the punter, so several plays can tie for the top spot
n_tied <- sum(play_scores$points == max(play_scores$points))
cat(n_tied, "play(s) tied for the highest score\n")
play_scores %>% head(max(5, n_tied)) %>% select(player_name, team, season, week, qtr, points, stats, desc) %>% kable(digits = 2)

top_play <- play_scores[1, ]
cat("\n**Worst single play:**", top_play$player_name, "-", top_play$points, "points\n\n", top_play$desc)
player_long %>% filter(game_id == top_play$game_id, play_id == top_play$play_id, player_id == top_play$player_id) %>%
  breakdown() %>% kable(digits = 2)
```

## Highest-scoring quarter

```{r peak-quarter}
qtr_scores <- player_long %>%
  group_by(game_id, qtr, player_id) %>%
  summarise(player_name = first(player_name), team = first(team), season = first(season), week = first(week), points = sum(points), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(points))

qtr_scores %>% head(5) %>% kable(digits = 2)

top_q <- qtr_scores[1, ]
player_long %>% filter(game_id == top_q$game_id, qtr == top_q$qtr, player_id == top_q$player_id) %>%
  breakdown() %>% kable(digits = 2, caption = paste(top_q$player_name, "- Wk", top_q$week, "Q", top_q$qtr))
```

## Highest-scoring half

```{r peak-half}
half_scores <- player_long %>%
  group_by(game_id, game_half, player_id) %>%
  summarise(player_name = first(player_name), team = first(team), season = first(season), week = first(week), points = sum(points), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(points))

half_scores %>% head(5) %>% kable(digits = 2)

top_h <- half_scores[1, ]
player_long %>% filter(game_id == top_h$game_id, game_half == top_h$game_half, player_id == top_h$player_id) %>%
  breakdown() %>% kable(digits = 2, caption = paste(top_h$player_name, "- Wk", top_h$week, top_h$game_half))
```
